method: All captured views inspected in labeled sheets, plus original side/underside/cockpit/leg and candidate side/engine details at full size.
findings: Original underbody uses broad nested loops and different gauges, with a thinner low return. Prior routing was short and tucked too tightly.
Control leads in the original follow the bar into the neck; reroute the existing front pair accordingly.
First candidate return runs encroached on rear cargo space; second build tucks the rise inboard of unchanged case bodies.
First candidate thin loop showed angularity; redistribute its existing rings toward bends with no added topology.
Final twelve routes retain gauge hierarchy, route separation and leg service bows. Existing collars and socket barrels follow the new terminals.
limits: Fused original conceals junction semantics; names such as supply/return are descriptive modeling labels, not game-system canon.
Preserved packed rubber/steel maps carry existing surface texture; no new corrugation mesh or new texture maps in this routing pass.
Static sampled proximity does not certify moving steering/joints, hose flex, dressed rider clearance, every clamp/collar intersection or structural loading.
